description: Apply effects (drop shadow, inner shadow, layer blur, background blur) to a node. Use mode REPLACE (default) to overwrite all effects, or APPEND to add to existing ones.

effects.description: One or more effects to apply

color.description: Shadow color with alpha (shadow types only)

offset.description: Shadow offset in px (shadow types only, default {x:0, y:4})

spread.description: Shadow spread in px (shadow types only, default 0)

mode.description: REPLACE overwrites all existing effects (default). APPEND adds to the existing effects array.

name: set_effect
